base:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: a single production-ready transparent PNG chibi upper-body character sprite for the Orbis Android companion widget.
Primary request: translate the user's ORIGINAL pencil character design (Image 1) into a polished Q/chibi illustration, with rendering polish and widget framing comparable to Image 2.
Input images: Image 1 is the ONLY identity, hair silhouette and costume design reference. Image 2 is ONLY the painted anime-chibi art style, head/body proportion and waist-up framing reference; do NOT copy its brown hair, face identity, black shirt, ring or private character traits.
Subject: a youthful masculine humanoid AI service assistant. Soft layered medium blue hair, slim long side locks, the small upward hair tuft in the sketch, luminous BLUE eyes, fair face, a gentle restrained smile. Small dark headset with a fine boom microphone near his cheek. White asymmetric fitted high-collar work uniform with pale blue-grey seams, an inset small glowing cyan inverted-triangle switch at the neck; a tiny simple BLUE whale silhouette badge on the chest, no lettering. Silver metallic articulated hands with understated finger joints, not gloves. Slim elegant shoulders.
Pose: neutral welcoming default pose, upper body upright and nearly frontal, both metallic hands held loosely together below the chest. Calm, attentive and quietly lively, not stern.
Style: exquisite clean anime chibi illustration, large expressive head but not toddler-like, softly shaded detailed blue hair and fine linework, restrained glossy eyes, subtle fabric rendering and metal highlights.
Composition: 1024x1536 portrait framing. One character only, centered bust from whole hair tuft to waist, every finger completely inside frame, generous transparent margins. Head stays front-facing for reuse with expression layers. No props, no room, no card.
Constraints: genuinely transparent background, no backdrop gradient, no vignette, no cast shadow, no text, no watermark, no border, no checkerboard painted into pixels. Keep the design recognizably different from Image 2's private character.
